description: Transvaalbuurt 1920-1921 low rows (De la Reijstraat 25-42, Kraaipanstraat 5-61, Transvaalkade 103-105): 5.7-6.2 m dark red-brown brick fronts of two storeys (upstairs and downstairs flats) under a steep red-tile roof with roof lights, a thin cream eaves board at about 6.1 m; a cream-painted timber canted bay through both storeys on the wide axis (a boarded panel between the ground and first-floor lights), a pair of dark blue flat doors under a top light on the narrow axis with a small square window over them; mirrored in pairs so the door pairs meet at every second party wall

match.note: No eaves criterion: the evidence eaves of these low fronts is 6.2-8.0 m where the 3DBAG front reads over 6 m and the dak70p fallback (10.4-11.3 m) elsewhere (auto-place.ts: front eaves under 6 m are not trusted), so no storey pitch holds both; ridge 11.9-12.4 m but the evidence roof max is capped 1.3-1.5 m over the dak70p eaves (no roof criterion); bouwlagen 3 (the attic counts). The strips read the cream eaves board at 6.0-6.2 m over the pavement. BAG 1920-1921; the 1922 rows of Colensostraat and Transvaalstraat 131-143 share the roof and height but have no canted bay. Wall: the trim-normalised strip walls of De la Reijstraat 28-42 read #7d675d-#8b6b63 (dE 10 scores 1, 20 scores 0.5). yearSlack 0: the 1922 rows of Transvaalstraat 131-143 and Colensostraat share eaves, roof and wall but have no bay (they took this type at the default slack of 2)

eaves.note: a cream eaves board 0.25 m deep at 6.0-6.3 m (De la Reijstraat 28-42 strip 2023), 0.4 m out, the red-tile roof face rising behind it; the roof lights in the tile face (two per house) are not drawn

door-left.note: the door pair on the left axis; mirrored when the strip reads it on the right

roof.evidence: 3DBAG LoD2.2 over the rows: a long saddle along the street from the 5.8-6.6 m eaves to a ridge at 11.9-12.4 m, front slope about 55 deg; the strips show that steep tile face with roof lights rising from the eaves board. Drawn as the front attic at 55 deg capped by 3DBAG (the LoD2.2 roof itself left low gablets at the gutter of every pand on De la Reijstraat 25-39, 2026-11-01)

rhythm.bays: a narrow door axis (a pair of flat doors under a top light) and a wide axis with a canted timber bay through both storeys
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: door pair + bay | 1: small square window + bay
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored in pairs: the door pairs meet on every second party wall, the bays on the others
rhythm.groundFloor: door pair at the party wall, the canted bay window
rhythm.roofline: a thin cream eaves board, a steep red-tile roof face with roof lights
